_rules: 0) 保留 ** 强调、`code`、链接与表格结构，与中文侧逐块对应。
1) 官方英文引文原样保留；档案里的中文转述引文在英文侧标注 (translated)，不伪造英文原文。
2) 「未核验/官方未给」等未知语义不升级；不借翻译改事实。

axes.model_access: **The UI screenshot on the official overview page lists the model picker directly**: Gemini-family and Claude-family, GPT-OSS etc. shown side by side as selectable (a screenshot-shown list; not verified one by one as a complete list). The CLI session header shows the current model (e.g. Gemini 3.8 Flash High). The model surface is decided by Google-side listing; third-party model availability changes with official adjustments.
axes.runtime: **Four official surfaces** (overview page wording): Antigravity App (desktop, v2.5+, a standalone command center evolved from the Agent Manager), Antigravity CLI (a terminal client that runs on local shell / remote cloud environments / SSH), Editor extensions (extensions for 5 IDEs), Antigravity SDK (a Python programming runtime). App/CLI/IDE-extension execution all happen in your local environment; the SDK is "run an agent harness in a few lines of Python".
axes.local_files: **The official settings docs state the boundary explicitly**: by default the agent can only access the active project folder and `~/.gemini/antigravity-ide/` (artifacts, knowledge items and configuration all live in this local directory); "non-workspace file access" is an explicit toggle, off by default.
axes.background: **The official narrative covers both synchronous pair-programming and asynchronous background agents**: the App supports archiving conversations per project and scheduled messages/tasks that handle routine work automatically; the CLI can schedule background subagents.
axes.tools: The Artifacts mechanism (implementation plans / verification reports / proposed changes) is a core surface; browser-in-the-loop does front-end automated verification. **MCP support status: not verified one by one** (no standalone MCP page found in the official docs navigation; not read page by page this pass).
axes.context: Knowledge items land in the local `~/.gemini/antigravity-ide/` directory (settings docs framing). How productized cross-session memory is: not verified one by one.
axes.permissions: **The official settings docs give a three-layer control surface**: terminal-command auto-execution (request review vs always continue + configurable allow/deny lists), the non-workspace file access toggle (off by default), and strict mode (restricts external resources and sensitive operations). Accounts go through the Google system.
axes.fit:
Good fit: wanting Google-family models plus multi-surface coordination (desktop command center / terminal / IDE extensions / SDK on one harness), scheduled tasks and background subagents, teams wanting an explicitly tunable "command execution policy".

Not a fit: mainland direct-connection scenarios (the main domain's direct connection is unstable), wanting artifacts kept outside the Google account system.
